propositions: T3 and T10 criteria are non-blocking despite actionable findings; enabling blocking at 0.90 threshold bounds blast radius during effectiveness monitoring

T10 DetGateRule requires infrastructure-related keywords (terraform, cloudformation, AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, etc.) to trigger vulnerability detection; non-matching plans bypass T10 LLM routing

T10 severity guidance restricts major/high-priority findings to four dangerous classes (destructive apply, wildcard grants, plaintext secrets, unauthenticated internet services) so lower-severity findings cannot cross the 0.90 blocking threshold
Pinned routing assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py and test_impact_model_versioning.py must be updated to reflect T3/T10 blocking posture and approved-blocking-set membership
T10 regex gate uses only text patterns (no file_impact arms) to detect infrastructure artifact mentions in plan changes; pure-docs changes skip T10 and are det-gated
